lead.tldr: DBS launches $110M fund with Granite Asia targeting IPO-stage AI tech startups for wealth clients. • Gemini enacts 25% layoffs exits key markets and loses top executives amid profitability struggles. • Bitcoin drops 4% below $65K triggers $458M liquidations as Fear and Greed hits historic low. • Standard Chartered forecasts stablecoins driving $1T T-bill demand by 2028 aiding Treasury flexibility. • BlackRock Apollo and Citadel acquire DeFi tokens signaling rising TradFi institutional adoption. • Vitalik Buterin proposes Ethereum transaction simulations to boost user security and certainty.

top_signals.title: DBS, Southeast Asia’s largest bank, partners with VC giant Granite Asia to counter the region's lack of capital
top_signals.summary: DBS, Southeast Asia's largest bank by assets, has partnered with Granite Asia, a VC firm managing $10 billion in assets, to launch a $110 million AI-focused IPO fund exclusively for DBS wealth clients. This fund, the first in a three-year collaboration, targets initial public offerings of high-growth AI and tech startups in Asia, addressing the region's capital shortage amid limited funding options compared to Western markets. DBS will support Granite Asia's funds and portfolio companies with services like subscription financing, M&A advisory, and IPO preparation, while Granite Asia offers early access to listings from its network that recently achieved five IPOs and 10 filings. The partnership matters for institutional investors as it provides differentiated exposure to Asia's expanding AI ecosystem, with broad participation from Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Europe.

top_signals.title: Tyler Winklevoss ‘Optimistic’ as Gemini Cuts Jobs and Sells BTC
top_signals.summary: Gemini is cutting jobs and exiting key markets, while Winklevoss Capital is reportedly trimming its Bitcoin holdings. Despite these developments, Tyler Winklevoss expresses optimism.

top_signals.title: Stablecoins could drive $1 trillion in T-bill demand, giving Treasury room to shift issuance: Standard Chartered
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered predicts that stablecoin growth could lead to a $1 trillion increase in demand for U.S. Treasury bills by 2028. This increased demand could give the Treasury more flexibility in its issuance strategies.

top_signals.title: Binance Claims 25% of Staff Work in Compliance Roles
top_signals.summary: Binance claims that 25% of its staff work in compliance roles and defends its compliance record, citing a 97% drop in sanctions exposure. The exchange also denies firing investigators over Iran-linked findings.

top_signals.title: AI Assistants could Transform Governance: Buterin
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin believes AI, particularly large language models, could enhance decentralized governance models. This suggests a potential shift towards more efficient and automated decision-making processes within decentralized systems.

top_signals.title: AI Agent Lobstar Wilde Accidentally Sends $442K to Beggar
top_signals.summary: An AI agent created by an OpenAI employee accidentally sent $442,000 to someone. This appears to be a costly error highlighting potential risks associated with AI agents.

top_signals.title: How Pig-Butchering Crypto Scams Turn Trust Into a Financial Weapon
top_signals.summary: The article discusses "pig-butchering" crypto scams, which use emotional manipulation, fake profits, and social engineering to defraud victims of millions. These scams exploit trust to drain funds from individuals worldwide.

top_signals.title: Prediction markets are bending insider trading rules. But will they break them?
top_signals.summary: The article discusses the increasing concerns around insider trading in prediction markets, highlighting the blurred lines between having an edge and breaking the law. It mentions that bills are being drafted to address loopholes in the current regulations.

top_signals.title: The Russian economy is now eating itself to death as Putin's war on Ukraine destroys future capacity, former central bank adviser says
top_signals.summary: A former central bank advisor claims the Russian economy is deteriorating due to the war in Ukraine, likening it to a body consuming its own muscle tissue. The advisor, Prokopenko, suggests that Putin's war is destroying the country's future economic capacity.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin Pitches Transaction Simulation Security Idea
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin proposes integrating transaction simulations into Ethereum to enhance user certainty regarding transaction processing. This feature aims to provide users with a clearer understanding of how their transactions will be executed on the network.

top_signals.title: The Funding: Why TradFi giants like BlackRock are buying DeFi tokens now
top_signals.summary: BlackRock, Apollo, and Citadel have reportedly acquired or agreed to acquire DeFi tokens. This signals increasing institutional interest and adoption of decentralized finance.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Plunges 4% as Fear and Greed Index Hits Historic Low
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin's price plunged below $65,000, wiping out weekend gains. The drop resulted in $458 million in liquidations, impacting leveraged traders.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, The crypto and Web3 landscape is evolving rapidly, and we're witnessing pivotal moments that reshape how capital flows to innovation. Consider what's happening across global markets. In Southeast Asia, DBS, the region's largest bank, has partnered with Granite Asia to launch a $110 million AI-focused IPO fund. This collaboration addresses a critical gap: while Western markets overflow with capital, Asia's high-growth tech startups struggle for institutional funding. By combining traditional banking infrastructure with venture expertise, they're building bridges between emerging founders and institutional wealth. This model demonstrates why regional expertise matters in crypto and tech investing. Meanwhile, the institutional adoption of digital assets continues accelerating. Standard Chartered projects that stablecoin growth could drive $1 trillion in additional U.S. Treasury bill demand by 2028, fundamentally reshaping how institutions manage liquidity and capital flows. This isn't speculation, it's infrastructure evolution. At Blockwall, we've always believed that Web3's future depends on disciplined investors backing bold founders solving real problems. Whether it's DeFi infrastructure, blockchain-enabled IoT, or next-generation financial protocols, the founders building these solutions need partners who understand both the technology and the market. The convergence of traditional finance and decentralized systems is no longer coming, it's here. Institutions are moving. Capital is flowing. The question isn't whether Web3 will matter, but which founders will lead the next wave of innovation. What's the biggest challenge you're solving in Web3 right now? #Web3 #Crypto #Blockchain #CryptoVC
